All cited upper boundaries have liquid_at_upper_boundary=true, so they are reported only as liquid-involved upper disappearance behavior, not solid-state solvus values.

Balanced alternative C001 (Ni 1.5, Er 0.4, Zr 0.4 at.%) is justified explicitly as a worse-J tradeoff alloy, not as a coarsening-first contender. B001:C001:phase_stability shows it is feasible with L12_250=3.1990436089735828, L12_660=0.8923485574934417, Al3Zr_250=0, Al3Zr_660=0.9968651939905895, boundary=945.3125000000001 C and liquid_at_upper_boundary=true.
